subject: Transportation Systems
title: Reusable Rockets
description: A quick win: understand Reusable Rockets.

hook.text: For 60 years, rockets were disposable. SpaceX landed one in 2015 and cut launch costs by 90%.

buildup.text: A Falcon 9 booster now flies, lands on a drone ship, and launches again within weeks.

discovery.text: Reusability turned space launch from a government-only activity into a commercial industry.

twist.text: Some boosters have flown over 20 times. The record seemed impossible when the first one landed.

climax.text: Starship aims to make rockets as reusable as airplanes—fly daily, refuel, fly again.

punchline.text: Landing the rocket was the breakthrough. Reusing it was the revolution.

quiz.question: By how much did SpaceX's reusable rockets cut launch costs?
